text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Sonar API Spec Cache

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * *' # Daily at 06:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-sonar-api-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Authenticate as octavia-bot
        id: octavia-auth
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: api.github.com
          scope: user:email
          policy: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["repo:status"],"Resource":["*"]}]}'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm@9.4.0

      - name: Fetch latest Sonar API spec
        run: |
          curl -L https://airbyte-sonar-prod.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/openapi/latest/app.json -o sonar-api-spec.json

      - name: Format spec with prettier
        run: npx prettier --write sonar-api-spec.json

      - name: Check if spec has changed
        id: check-changes
        run: |
          git diff --quiet sonar-api-spec.json || echo "::set-output name=has_changes::true"

      - name: Create PR if changes exist
        if: steps.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "octavia-bot"
          git config --global user.email "octavia-bot@airbyte.io"
          git add sonar-api-spec.json
          git commit -m "chore(sonar): update API spec"
          git push origin HEAD:regenerate-sonar-api-spec
          gh pr create --title "chore(sonar): update API spec" --body "Automatically regenerated Sonar API spec." --label "auto-merge,autogenerated,documentation"
```
